intent: Compare the shares reporting a great deal and a fair amount of confidence and determine whether together they form a majority.

requirements.question: How does the video present the required bars in this chart?
Is the combined 74% at-least-some figure obligatory even though it is derived rather than printed?

units.claim: All 2 required bar marks or stacked segments appear in the final chart.
accept: all 2 required data marks are visible in the final chart state
every grouped bar and every stacked segment is present
reject: omitting any required bar or stacked segment
replacing missing marks with a summary total or subtitle
units.evidence: All G0-required marks for the final chart state are visible and identifiable.

units.claim: Among U.S. adults, 26% report a great deal of confidence and 48% a fair amount; together they total 74% and form a majority.
accept: about three-quarters said a great deal or a fair amount
26% great deal plus 48% fair amount equals 74% at least some confidence
about one-quarter reported a great deal of confidence
about half reported a fair amount of confidence
units.evidence: The chart must show both the 26% and 48% components or a combined 74% 'at least some' segment. The 'A great deal' bar/segment must be labeled or readable as 26%. The 'A fair amount' bar/segment must be labeled or readable as 48%.

optional_valid: A fair amount was the most common of the two shown confidence levels (48%).
The great-deal share (26%) is about one-quarter of adults.
The fair-amount share (48%) is roughly half of adults.

clip_hardcase.reason: The reference SVG has no explicit data-role=bar mark, so visual-unit reconstruction needs manual review.

hardcases.handling: Requires human visual inspection before semantic scoring.
